arabic_text: إلهِي فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي خَيْرَ الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولى لِقِلَّةِ شُكْرِي، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي،
transliteration: ilāhī falā taḥrimnī khayra al-ākhirati wal-ūlā liqillati shukrī waġfir li mā taʿlamu min dhunūbī
english_text: My God, so deprive me not of the good of the last world and the first because of the paucity of my thanksgiving and forgive me the sins of mine which Thou knowest!

arabic_text: إنْ تُعَذِّبْ فَأَنَا الظَّالِمُ، الْمُفَرِّطُ، الْمُضَيِّعُ، الاثِمُ، الْمُقَصِّرُ، الْمُضْجِعُ، الُمُغْفِلُ حَظَّ نَفْسِي،
transliteration: 'in tu'adhhib fa ana al-thalimu, al-mufraṭu,' al-muḍayyiʿu, al-āthimu, al-muqaṣṣiru, al-mudjiʿu al-mughfilu haẓẓa nafsi
english_text: If Thou chastisest, I am the wrongdoer, the neglecter, the negligent, the sinner, the derelict, the sluggard, the heedless of the share of my soul!
And if Thou forgivest - Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful!
